Q: What must a signed bearer token prove before an owned resource can be returned?
spoken: Verify the declared token profile: trusted issuer and keys, permitted algorithm, audience, validity period and relevant claims. Map that authenticated identity to server-side authorization and scope the authoritative resource query. A valid signature alone does not prove that a token was issued for this API or that its subject owns the requested record.

Verify the declared token profile: trusted issuer and keys, permitted algorithm, audience, validity period and relevant claims. Concrete engineering case: A correctly signed token for another service is accepted because the API never checks audience.

Boundary defense: No. Audience identifies an intended recipient. Ownership, role and lifecycle permissions remain resource-specific decisions.
